title: leanSPHINCS for developers: how to build on Post-Quantum Ethereum
description: After 10 months of public contributions, research and development, Matteo Vicari and Alessandro Baiocchi from Riva Labs dive deep on post-quantum Ethereum, covering the details of it's core pillar, leanSPHINCS. The talk covers all the most important technical details of the signature scheme and what ecosystem developers and operators should do to prepare.
